articles.title: Sean McAdam: Red Sox wrap up playoff bid the hard way — which is fitting for their season
articles.description: The Red Sox had to wait — first to turn their season around, and then Sunday, for some outside help. Ultimately, they got to their destination.

articles.title: Red Sox loss included ‘nightmare’ first inning for starter, return of important reliever and veteran stays hot at plate (Notebook)
articles.description: Patrick Sandoval stumbled badly at the start while Tyron Guerrero returned and Trevor Story remained hot.

articles.title: Red Sox clinch playoff spot — and have franchise legend’s grandson to thank
articles.description: The Red Sox lost the final two games of their weekend set against the Rays at Tropicana Field, but they still clinched a playoff spot Sunday thanks to Mike Yastrzemski hitting a big homer to beat the Astros.

articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Clinch on hold after second straight defeat
articles.description: A chance to wrap up a playoff spot on their own was fumbled by the Red Sox, who were beaten by the Rays.

articles.title: Two Red Sox front office assistant GMs interview for Athletics’ opening
articles.description: Two assistant general managers with the Red Sox are in the running for a GM opening with the A's.

articles.title: Do Red Sox pitching plans for next series offer a hint for postseason rotation? Chad Tracy explains
articles.description: The Red Sox announced their pitching plans for the next series, and those might offer a clue about what they intend to do in the playoffs.

articles.description: Brayan Bello turned in his best start of the season. Also, Caleb Durbin made the wrong choice in the ninth and Connor Wong has two passed balls in the last two games.

articles.title: Red Sox getting early taste of playoffs even before postseason arrives
articles.description: The Red Sox didn't get a win to clinch a playoff spot. But for the past week, they've been playing quality opponents in taut environments, and that may be the next best thing.

articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Walk-off loss puts playoff celebration on hold
articles.description: The Red Sox will have to wait until Sunday - at least - before clinching a wild card spot.

articles.title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras buoyed by improvement in right hand, no longer fears fracture

articles.title: Red Sox’ Ranger Suarez sets a career high in walks, but navigates tightrope in win
articles.description: It wasn't the cleanest outing for Ranger Suarez, but it was plenty good enough to get a win.
